key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2C72
name: clear_bit0_across_pointer_table
description: Walks a three-entry table of pointers held in shared variables, clearing the lowest bit of the byte at offset five in each block. It then zeroes two shared words and returns the data register unchanged.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2C9C
name: copy_two_words_from_block
description: Copies two 16-bit values from offsets fourteen and sixteen of a block pointed to by a shared variable into two shared variables.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2CBA
name: rewrite_tag_in_buffer
description: Compares the first four bytes of a buffer with the ASCII tag N30L and rewrites them as N22B when they match. It then always sets the fourth byte to the letter B.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2CFA
name: clear_flag_and_zero_field
description: Clears the lowest bit of the byte at offset five in a block and zeroes the byte at offset thirteen, after a short sequence of calls and a store to a shared variable.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2D22
name: toggle_bit_in_call_sequence
description: Runs a fixed sequence of routine calls twice, flipping a shared bit once per pass.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2D4C
name: dispatch_tag_and_poll_loop
description: Matches a four-byte tag at the buffer: tag N22B triggers one routine call, tags N23B and N24B skip the polling, and any other tag initialises state bytes and runs a polling loop. Every path stores 70 into a shared variable before returning.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2E10
name: write_tag_then_poll
description: Writes the letter C into the fourth byte of a buffer, makes a set of calls, initialises state bytes and runs a polling loop. It then stores 70 into a shared variable and clears another.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2E54
name: adjust_record_field_and_dispatch
description: Adds fifty to a 16-bit field at offset thirty-eight of a record, then calls a set of routines whose number depends on whether a shared variable equals minus two.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:2ECA
name: set_default_state_values
description: Clears a shared flag, calls five routines, then sets a shared byte to 15 and two shared words to 200 and 250, and clears the flag again.

name: toggle_bit_after_two_calls
description: Calls two routines and then flips the lowest bit of a shared byte. Nothing else happens.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:3096
name: copy_record_field_word
description: Calls one routine and then copies a 16-bit value from offset thirty-eight of a shared block into the same offset of the record held in an address register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:30AC
name: process_six_records_then_finish
description: Calls a routine for each of six consecutive 15-byte entries starting at a shared base, then makes several more calls and stores 70 into a shared variable.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:3110
name: clear_flag_and_run_calls
description: Clears a shared variable and then calls four routines in sequence.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:322A
name: clear_block_flag_then_calls
description: Clears the lowest bit of the byte at offset five of a shared block, makes six routine calls, and stores 103 in a shared variable.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:327A
name: clear_flag_six_calls
description: Clears a shared variable, makes six routine calls, and stores 103 in another shared variable.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:35A6
name: map_input_code_to_command
description: Translates an input byte such as a key code into a command value by checking shared state and branching on known codes, then returns the value from a lookup table or from a routine call. Several branches also update shared state before returning.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:35B6
name: dispatch_input_code_to_actions
description: Handles an input byte by branching on known codes and updating shared state, then calls the matching action routines and a table-driven update. It returns no value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:3942
name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and does no work, so calling it has no effect.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:3AAC
name: store_table_entry_by_index
description: Reads a byte from a table at an index of three times the low byte of a data register and stores it as a 16-bit value at a fixed memory address.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:3AB0
name: load_table_entry_by_index
description: Reads a byte from the same table at an index of three times the low byte of a data register and stores it as a 16-bit value in a shared variable.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:3ACC
name: decode_input_pair_against_state
description: Interprets a pair of input bytes against the current mode state, updating mode variables and calling the routines that match each pair. It returns a status value to its caller.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:41EE
name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns immediately, so it only forwards the call.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:426C
name: reset_record_fields_and_loop
description: Subtracts fifty from a 16-bit field at offset thirty-eight of a record and copies a value from the record's offset fourteen, less thirteen, into a shared word. It sets a flag bit when a state value is six, then makes three passes of routine calls that update a shared variable.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:431E
name: set_flag_bits_then_call
description: Sets a group of bit flags in a byte just before a pointer, clears a shared bit, and makes several routine calls.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:442C
name: loop_calls_with_stepped_index
description: Runs an index from 73 up to 226 in steps of 17, making two routine calls each pass and a third call on certain passes that depend on the index and a shared byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:44B8
name: repeat_calls_by_table_difference
description: Subtracts a shared word from a table word at the same index, then runs two routine calls that many times.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:44D4
name: repeat_two_calls_by_counter
description: Calls two routines in a loop that repeats as many times as a word in a data register counts down from.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:450A
name: set_wait_values_then_call
description: Sets a shared word to 1006, makes routine calls, then sets it to 1005 and calls a routine with the data register value. The text tag DSSG is referenced nearby.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:4554
name: run_save_game_selection_menu
description: Runs the save-game selection loop, reading keyboard codes from the keyboard serial register and updating menu state until a confirmation code is received. The prompt text Select game to save is referenced.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:483C
name: claim_key_slot_for_input
description: Maps three special input codes to a key value and searches a four-entry table for it. If it is not found, the routine frees any buffer in the claimed slot, allocates a new one, and records the slot; if it is found, it returns without change.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:4872
name: compute_record_offset_164
description: Returns a shared index multiplied by 164, giving a byte offset into a fixed-size record array.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:4888
name: compute_entry_offset_seven
description: Returns a shared index multiplied by seven.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:489A
name: pack_save_state_into_buffer
description: Copies six bytes of shared state into a buffer, then copies three-byte records until a terminator, followed by sixteen words and several shared values. It serialises the save data used by the save-game selection.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:48B0
name: unpack_save_state_from_buffer
description: Reads saved data back from a buffer into shared state, reversing the packing step. It returns one when the first byte is zero and no save is active, and zero after restoring the fields.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:48C8
name: pack_save_records_into_buffer
description: Makes two routine calls, then copies a table of three-byte records until a terminator byte, followed by sixteen words and several shared values into a buffer. It serialises save data without the leading six-byte header.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:493E
name: copy_strided_rows_until_terminator
description: Copies bytes from a source into a destination, advancing the source by a table count multiplied by a stride from a data register, until the table reaches its terminator value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:49D6
name: restore_strided_rows_until_terminator
description: Copies bytes from a buffer back into a strided destination, advancing the destination by a table count multiplied by a stride until the table reaches its terminator value. It also makes many routine calls that touch the keyboard serial register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:4CC6
name: toggle_empty_slot_flags
description: When a flag is zero it clears the lowest bit of a byte in a shared block, then for each of four records holding zero it clears the byte at offset thirteen and toggles the bytes at offsets nine, ten and fifty-four. When the flag is nonzero it makes one routine call instead.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:4D16
name: write_two_digit_number_backwards
description: Writes the last two decimal digits of a data register into a fixed buffer, filling from right to left, then stores the letter R after them.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:4D1C
name: write_two_digits_at_pointer
description: Writes the last two decimal digits of a data register into a buffer addressed by an address register, filling from right to left, then stores the letter R after them.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:4D3A
name: run_frame_state_machine
description: Runs a repeating state-machine loop that polls the keyboard serial register and the raster position counter, updates shared mode variables and calls routines for each transition. It only returns on an exit path.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5638
name: clear_table_entries_set_field
description: Sets a shared flag and a record field at offset thirty-eight to 830, then walks a table of pointers clearing consecutive nonzero entries and calling a routine for each one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:56D6
name: trigger_pending_action_if_set
description: When a shared byte is nonzero and not the value 34, or when its top bit is set, it makes one routine call and sets two shared variables to 48 and 1.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:570C
name: switch_to_indexed_state_entry
description: Looks up a state byte in a table at the index held in a data register. When it differs from a nonzero shared byte, it switches to it, makes routine calls and then re-runs the pending-action check.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:571E
name: switch_to_state_by_index
description: Switches the shared state byte to the value in a data register when that value differs from a nonzero current state, makes routine calls and then re-runs the pending-action check.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:57A8
name: call_with_saved_shared_value
description: Saves a shared 32-bit variable, makes one routine call, then restores the variable and returns the data and address registers.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:57C2
name: lookup_key_in_two_tables
description: Maps a comma and a few symbols to replacement codes, then scans two tables for the resulting byte and makes routine calls on each match.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:57CA
name: lookup_key_in_two_tables
description: Maps a comma and a few symbols to replacement codes, then scans two tables for the resulting byte and makes routine calls on each match.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:57CE
name: lookup_key_in_two_tables
description: Maps a comma and a few symbols to replacement codes, then scans two tables for the resulting byte and makes routine calls on each match.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5848
name: fill_entry_record_from_block
description: Copies seven input bytes into a shared record, derives a status byte from the first byte and a table lookup, and stores a 32-bit value from a table into the entry selected by the first byte.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5922
name: repeat_call_grid_from_table
description: Reads a row count and a column count from a table at an address register and makes a routine call for every cell in that grid.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5976
name: call_single_routine_return
description: Calls one routine and returns; it adds nothing else.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:598E
name: initialise_and_update_table_slot
description: On its first run, sets a shared byte to 66 and marks it initialised. It then reads two bytes from a record: a first byte above 119 stores a 32-bit value into a table slot, and a flag bit triggers a search of a six-byte table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:59BA
name: update_table_slot_from_record
description: Reads two bytes from a record: a first byte above 119 stores a 32-bit value into a table slot, and a flag bit triggers a search of a six-byte table for that byte. It makes four routine calls.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5AB4
name: set_active_block_pointer
description: Makes seven routine calls, then sets a shared block pointer to the value of a second shared pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5B2C
name: call_sixteen_routines_in_sequence
description: Makes sixteen routine calls in a row and returns; the routine has no other work.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5C0C
name: lookup_table_entry_with_counter
description: Increments a per-slot counter, then scans a sorted table of six-byte entries for the key in a data register. On a match it returns the entry value and makes routine calls when the entry flag byte is nonzero; otherwise it returns minus one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5C10
name: record_key_lookup_entry
description: Increments the same per-slot counter and scans the sorted six-byte table for the key. On a match it stores the matched key in a shared word and returns the entry value, making routine calls when the flag byte is nonzero; otherwise it returns minus one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5C1C
name: search_sorted_table_for_key
description: Scans a sorted table of six-byte entries for the key in a data register and stores the matched key in a shared word. It returns the entry value, making routine calls when the flag byte is nonzero, or minus one when the key is not found.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5C76
name: copy_sixteen_words_into_record
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit words from a source pointer into a record field beginning at offset thirty-six.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5C84
name: complement_two_bytes
description: Stores the bitwise complement of each of two source bytes into a destination.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5C94
name: scan_template_text_offset
description: Returns early when a shared flag is set. Otherwise it makes many routine calls, walks two byte strings in step with a fixed offset until they differ, and sets a shared byte to the less-than sign. The referenced text shows the page, paragraph and word template it matches.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)[a2]/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7)[a2].adf:ds:0:5D40
